status: prospective; freeze source and independent numerical validation before evaluation
method: stationary finite binomial sums; float64 with independent rational workflow checks
allocation_ablation: One prospectively chosen halving of the original exploratory target isolates whether its sampling precision justifies its cost. Only strict sampling uses this ablation; no sample-size search or reduced-target/shared-baseline combination. Calibration, candidate and confirmation targets unchanged. This is not a practical default.
byte_accounting: Determine each effective candidate's canonical materialized request bytes before outcomes; compare editable bytes removed while preserving fixed decision input. Content lengths define fixtures and are not provider token counts.
primary_metric: Weighted E(all charged calls) / weighted P(confirmed useful result)
useful_result: Instruction retained; at least half editable materialized bytes removed; complete final sweep; single fresh confirmation preserves

prospective_decision.benefit: Positive aggregate reduction in the primary metric beyond independently assessed numerical error. Report absolute and relative savings; no percentage cutoff and no benefit-at-every-position rule.
prospective_decision.usefulness: Preserve the original stationary equal-workload 0.80 minimum confirmed-useful probability at every position. Apply the same 0.80 per-position floor to mild degradation for any configuration promoted to further validation, reporting reference failures as well. Uneven-workload success remains separately reported, without inventing a native applicability guarantee.
prospective_decision.budget: Every terminal's lazy candidate work has zero unsampled charges and no more original arms than strict on the same path; cover the actual worst path and retain fresh confirmation capacity.
prospective_decision.risk: Existing 0.055 conditional confirmation-error ceiling and 0.005 additional selected-result false-preservation risk remain required. Stationary arithmetic alone cannot enable production sharing.
prospective_decision.policy_preference: Prefer group 2 if both policies improve efficiency; select group 4 only if its incremental benefit is demonstrated and justifies wider shared-control exposure and complexity.
prospective_decision.next_stage: A positive stationary decision requires a separately frozen bounded failure/drift/expiry/resume evaluation before adoption. Preserve negative and inconclusive findings, with no native or paid cost claims.

numerical_validation.rational_toy_workflow: All terminal masses, calibration failure, cost components, statuses and useful confirmation independently reproduced with a nonzero calibration threshold
numerical_validation.main_precision: Finite-sum probabilities checked against independent rational workflow and 60-digit Decimal PMFs/admission sums. Apply conservative diagnostic allowances to ratio comparisons; these are not certified accumulated-error bounds.
